title: Quick Prototype
author: Nez_Coupe
selftext:
So, I've got some fresh slop hot off the press. I had an idea for how I'd like to make an rpg setup wise, and I'm wondering what y'all think works or doesn't work regarding just general setup. All the sprites are just slop placeholders right now, I'll be updating them manually. There's no gameplay yet, but I'm going to resurrect a previous rpg I was working on with a lot of actual gameplay and just porting it over to the view style. Let me know what sucks, what doesn't, if it all sucks, etc. 

[https://youtu.be/uEshaDD-D0I](https://youtu.be/uEshaDD-D0I)
